integrity: The theorem is proved analytically in RESULT.md; verify.py is a finite numerical and exact-rational cross-check, not an independent or exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: The graph-independent exact outer sphere requires simple positive-degree noncomplete regular rim graphs and standard coordinate-plane filled disks; the converse concerns only interior uniform-rim maximizing normals. No results about generic irregular rims, ellipsoids or volume are claimed. Independent validation not performed.
title: Graph-independent outer spheres and cubical contact rigidity for regular-rim discotopes
